title: Approximate tangent planes of a cone are invariant under dilations
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be a cone (IsConeCurrent C) and let R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) represent C. Then for every r > 0, approxTangentPlane n M (r·x) = approxTangentPlane n M x for R.measure-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, approxTangentPlane n R.carrier (r • x) = approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x
